name: Hong Kong
blurb: A vertical harbour city with mountain trails minutes from the towers.
cities: Hong Kong Island
Central's skyscrapers, the Star Ferry, trams and dim sum in Sheung Wan.
Kowloon
Wong Tai Sin Temple, Kowloon Walled City Park and Chi Lin Nunnery.
Lantau Island
The Big Buddha, monasteries and mountain trails.
Sai Kung
Beaches, seafood and volcanic rock coastline.
Tsim Sha Tsui
A harbourfront promenade, the Avenue of Stars and the nightly Symphony of Lights.
Mong Kok & Yau Ma Tei
Street markets, neon signs and the Temple Street night market.
Sham Shui Po
Old-school dim sum, fabric markets and local street food.
Victoria Peak
The Peak Tram up to sweeping views over Victoria Harbour.
Stanley & Repulse Bay
South-side beaches, a seaside market and colonial Murray House.
Dragon's Back
A ridge hike above the sea that ends at Big Wave Bay.
Lamma Island
A car-free island of seafood restaurants and beach walks.
Tai O
A fishing village of stilt houses, with pink dolphin boat trips.
Cheung Chau
A lively island of seafood, temples and a famous bun festival.
Ngong Ping & the Big Buddha
The cable car over Lantau's hills to the giant bronze Tian Tan Buddha and Po Lin Monastery.
Hong Kong Disneyland
Disney's theme park on Lantau, with a Frozen-themed land and nightly fireworks.
Ocean Park
A hillside marine theme park with giant pandas, an aquarium and a cable car over the sea.
Wong Tai Sin Temple
Hong Kong's busiest temple, where visitors shake fortune sticks among incense smoke.
Chi Lin Nunnery & Nan Lian Garden
Tang-style timber halls built without nails, beside a classical Chinese garden.
West Kowloon Cultural District
The M+ museum, the Hong Kong Palace Museum and a harbourfront park facing the skyline.
Ten Thousand Buddhas Monastery & Sha Tin
A hillside climb past hundreds of golden Buddha statues, near the Heritage Museum.
Mai Po & Hong Kong Wetland Park
Wetlands and boardwalks on the edge of the city, famous for winter migratory birds.
Ping Shan Heritage Trail
A walk through the ancestral halls and walled villages of the Tang clan.
Lan Kwai Fong & SoHo
Hong Kong's nightlife quarter of bars and restaurants along the Mid-Levels escalator.
Tai Mo Shan
Hong Kong's highest peak, with misty trails, tea terraces and sunrise views.
Lion Rock
A short, steep hike to a lion-shaped crag with a sweeping view over Kowloon.
Plover Cove & Tai Po
A reservoir walled off from the sea, with cycling paths, hikes and fishing villages.
Tai Tam Reservoirs
Century-old stone dams and woodland walks on the Hong Kong Trail.
Shing Mun Reservoir
Lakeside paths and wild macaques, at the start of the MacLehose Trail's hill sections.
